description: This file contains platform-specific functions for handling image checks, upgrades, and configuration copying for various hardware boards in the OpenWrt project. It defines functions like platform_check_image, platform_do_upgrade, and platform_copy_config, which perform operations based on different board names using case statements.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the image for specific hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process tailored to specific hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data based on the target board.
